layouts_and_grids.reports_interface: Comprehensive orbital intelligence report view with high-res metrics summary, affected population estimates (Indian Census simulated grid data), infrastructure vulnerability breakdown, and one-click PDF (formatted multi-page viewable/printable report) + CSV export

accessibility.color_contrast: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 on their declared surface. Monospace telemetry uses high luminance cyan (#00E5FF) and slate-100 (#F8FAFC) against #070B14 and #0D1527.

accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit data-testid on every interactive button, input, comparison thumb, map layer toggle, and export trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up Tailwind v4 index.css with Outfit (heading), Geist (sans), and JetBrains Mono (telemetry numbers/labels). Set class='dark' in index.html to ensure dark mission control styling.
2. Install 'leaflet' and '@types/leaflet' in frontend via `yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet jspdf html2canvas` and import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css' in main.tsx or InteractiveFloodMap.tsx.
3. Use CARTO Dark Matter tiles ('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png') for the dark Leaflet map theme to match the Mission Control aesthetic.

4. Ensure simulated backend data in FastAPI contains rich realistic seed analyses across major flood-prone zones (Brahmaputra Basin, Kosi River Bihar, Kerala Periyar, Godavari Delta, Mahanadi Odisha, Yamuna Delhi) with lat/lng coordinates, inundated area (km²), affected population, severity score (Critical/High/Moderate/Low), confidence %, and before/after satellite image URLs.
5. For Before/After image comparison, build a robust draggable slider with keyboard arrow accessibility, synchronized zoom/pan options, and flood mask overlay toggle (cyan/coral heat overlay).

6. In Satellite Upload, provide pre-loaded sample datasets (e.g. 'Assam Floods 2024', 'Kerala Monsoons', 'Kosi Inundation') so testing and demonstration is instant and seamless without requiring manual image file uploads.
7. Include both PDF generation (using jsPDF / print stylesheet) and CSV export for flood intelligence reports.
8. Add `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, slider handles, and report triggers for verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop: Do not make generic centered cards or washed-out gradients. Stick to deep void blacks (#070B14), tactical border strokes (1px border-slate-800 with cyan-500/20 glow), and sharp monospace telemetry accents.
Every interaction needs tactile micro-feedback: hover border shifts, button press compression, live blinking radar status dots.
Never use full-screen flat gradients; use subtle textured grid lines, tactical borders, and glassmorphism headers with backdrop-blur.
All navigation and action buttons must include unambiguous role-based `data-testid` attributes.
